title: Time Passes · 1
paragraphs: “Well, only the future can tell us that,” Mr. Bankes said as he came in from the terrace.
“It’s nearly too dark to see anything,” said Andrew, coming up from the beach.
“One can scarcely tell which is sea and which is land,” said Prue.
“Are we leaving that light burning?” Lily asked as they took off their coats inside.
“Andrew,” she called over her shoulder, “just go and put out the hall light.”
One after another the lamps were all put out—except that Mr. Carmichael, who liked lying awake a while reading Virgil, kept his candle alight somewhat longer than everyone else.
